3 prior cases were confirmed fraud, although 1 prior cases were also cleared. Historical evidence therefore supports elevated concern but is not proof of the current event. Historical evidence is support/context only and is restricted to cases available before the current case opening.

The identity record contains id_15=New. This is treated as an observed identity/device indicator and not as proof of unauthorized activity.
